learned.description: Injects randomized delays plus telemetry suppression and graceful HUP restarts to throttle retry storms and stabilize flaky inference endpoints.

findings.summary: Critical retry storm on local inference endpoint triggering HTTP 500s; apply circuit-breaker delay and gracefully restart the worker to throttle and recover.
